purpose: Leakage-resistant Chronos-2 LoRA challengers for the 24-hour and 168-hour production TFT models.
dataset: Low Carbon London 2013 hourly household energy

selection.rule: Select each horizon by known-household validation macro MAE. Calibrate its central 80% interval on the same validation windows before any challenger access to cold-household targets.

audit.cold_households: the frozen 500-household cohort excluded from all local training and selection
audit.disclosure: The cohort is unseen by the challengers until selection.json is written, but it was used by prior incumbent experiments and is therefore not a pristine project-level holdout.
comparators: packaged Global TFT with production rolling-window normalization

promotion_policy: A horizon is replaced only if every frozen gate passes. Failure retains the existing Global TFT artifact and records the Chronos challenger as research evidence.
